notes.title: The Ashen Summers Patch
notes.content:
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/965032727806091354/1126338963016269884/summerevent.png?width=1202&height=676[/img]
[h2]Summer Event Shimmer Skin[/h2]
+Added Shimmer Summer Skin: Waverider by Soals and Valhalla
-This is a shimmer skin and requires unlocking by growing a Lurdusaurus to 2.0 Growth on a Life Cycle server
-If this skin is unlocked, it will be available for you to use across all servers. This includes Free Roam and Combat servers.
-The skin will be unlockable throughout the month of July
-This skin has a special barnacle layer that goes on top of the skin. If this skin is unlocked, this layer can be applied to any other Lurdusaurus skin.
  -Additionally, Unlocked Overlays can now be applied/removed from characters at any time, even on dinosaurs too old to otherwise edit their skin.
-This skin has bioluminescence on the body, the spikes, and on the eyes, as well as a metallic marking.

[h3]Nesting Event Skins[/h3]
Due to popular request, the Waverider skin may be nested by owners. The skin will not pass down some special marking types in order to encourage event participation. These markings include the Bio Layers and custom surface material files such as the metallic layer. 
In the future older event skins will be assessed for similar nesting compatibilities.

[h2]Achievements System[/h2]
Here is a list of new unlockable achievements:

	-Survivor (3 tiers) Survive to 1.5, 2.0, and 2.5 in gauntlet mode. Each tier unlocks a new achievement
	-Incest Survivor (4 tiers): Survive the egg, 1.5, 2.0 and 2.5 in gauntlet mode.
	-Mutation encounters: Discover 10 different mutations, either by receiving them or by smelling players with one or several of them. Unlocking this achievement will increase your chances to have any of the unique mutations when nesting.
	-Sickness survivor (3 tiers) Survive a small, mild and hard sickness.
	-For each dino: Grow to 2.5 or larger to unlock a new cosmetic, the elder eyes for this dino.

	[b]Seasonal Achievements:[/b]
		-New Summer Skin: Grow a lurdu to 2.0 in Gauntlet mode to unlock the summer skin.
                -Old: Past Seasonal achievements can be viewed in the Seasonal Gallery.

[h3]New Achievement Interface[/h3]
-You can access and view those achievements via a brand new interface called the [b]Achievement Gallery[/b], which we will complete as we add more achievements to the game! In this gallery, you will be able to see your progress on each achievement, which achievements are unlocked, and the progress on any if progress is relevant. 

-You can access this gallery via the escape menu: "View Achievements". You can also access this gallery via the character screen with a new button on the middle-left of the screen.

-Most of these achievements are per-server currently, with the exception of seasonal achievements which replicate across every server.

-Certain achievements wrap sub-galleries. You can access them by clicking the achievement. Achievement with sub-galleries have a label with the gallery name under their icon.
Hovering any achievement with the mouse will provide information about the current progress on that achievement.

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/721529804704448593/1126246159384584273/image.png?width=1221&height=676[/img]
[h2]Mutation and Offspring Skin System[/h2]
-Entirely reworked the skin system. This includes:
	-Better and more consistent skins
	-No broken or misnamed layers
	-Many other bug fixes related to skins
	-9 unique mutations that can happen at random
           --Including Bioluminescence, and improved Albino
	-1 mutation that can only happen from incest
	-Various client and server performance improvements tied to dealing with skin data and generating skins.

-When you have a mutation, it will be displayed on the skin editor UI. Certain mutations lock the skin completely to the mutated colors, others lock only specific layers.
-Mutations do not pass down to offspring, unless the offspring also has one or several mutations. 
-Receiving mutations count as discovering them for the achievement "Mutation Hunter".
-There is a dedicated gallery for the mutations. You can access it via the Achievement Gallery, Category Cosmetics -> Mutation Hunter.

[h2]Map Updates[/h2]
[h3]Spawn Point Regions[/h3]
+When selecting a spawn point on either Isla Titania or Volcano Bay, the player will now be asked what spawn point region they wish to spawn at.  There are four regions on both maps.  The player will then spawn at a randomly selected spawn point within that geographic region that's appropriate for their creature type (flyer, terrestrial, or aquatic).
    -The player is also prompted to select a spawn point after resurrecting or reincarnating

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/664066364662874125/1109267715778154526/AshenIslands.png?width=1261&height=676[/img]
[h2]Titania[/h2]
[h3]New Areas:[/h3]
Titania has been expanded and added new biomes to explore:

[h3]Ashen Island & Ashen Trenches[/h3]
[i]Located on a post-erupted volcano, the Ashen Zone features a chain of small islands and the deepest oceanic biome on the map: The Ashen Trenches. The landscape above and below is coated in a thick layer of ash, with newly growing plants making the most of the nutrient-rich soil. Players may make the journey here to this inhospitable area for its abundance of charcoal and other sickness combating elements.[/i]

+Added Rideable Raft that floats around the Ashen bay area.
+Ashen area has a special post processing that makes the scene appear more muted and ashy
+Ashen Area has custom music by Sachbun
+Ashen Area has 1 watersource which is not mandatory for the Watersources Visited trial.

[h3]Expanded Outlands & Outlands Coast[/h3]
The entirety of the Outlands is now accessible, including its cliffy coast line made of red clay-like stones. The coast has many small coves to explore and seek shelter from the rain.

[h3]Misc Changes[/h3]
+Updated the night shader to try and make it more visible and keep red hues better than previously (they will still be duller).
+Set up spawn regions on Titania into North, South, East, and West
    -When spawning a new creature, you now are prompted which spawn region you wish to spawn in
    -It also will show you the percentage of the total playerbase that exists in each region
    -You also get to pick your spawn region on Isla Titania when resurrecting
+New watersources: Pristine Falls, Muddy Oasis
+Added more spawn points to Titania + Expanded the Map Borders
+Cliffs have been overhauled on Titania to have procedural rocks. They can be removed with the foliage setting like other ground foliage.
+LOD and optimization changes to various assets. Some more complex materials have been simplified.
+First pass at texture painting Titan's Rise. 

[u][b]Note:[/b][/u] [i]Some of Titan's Rise is accessible, but the area is not developed and will be drastically altered in the future. Soal's does [u]not recommend logging off on the mountain.[/u][/i]

[h2]Other Maps[/h2]
+Bloodbath, an old and rather small map, should now be suitable for play
    -Optimized foliage assets on Bloodbath
    -Added critter-possessing shrines, ambient sounds, world event nodes, AI spawners, and deity shrines to Bloodbath
    -Fixed up the ocean, sky sphere, and other necessary map components on Bloodbath such that the map works properly
+Biomes and world event nodes have been added to Volcano Bay
+Fixed landscape texture tiling being too small on Volcano Bay
+Removed jungle trees from Volcano Bay
+Added the night filter and day filter from Titania onto Forest Island and FR Canvas so that it was easier to see in the dark on that map.

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/721529804704448593/1126255866044235927/20230705153948_1.jpg?width=1276&height=676[/img]
[h2]Other New Stuff[/h2]
[h3]Acro[/h3]
+Acrocanthosaurus has a totally new, updated set of animations
+Acrocanthosaurus now has Incest and Elder morphs

[h3]Morphs[/h3]
+Added new Megaraptor elder morph
+Added new Pachycephalosaurus elder, skinny, fat, baby, and incest morphs
+Added new Parasaurolophus elder, female-elder, incest, female-incest, elder-incest, elder-female-incest, and incest morphs
+Added Kronosaurus Elder and Incest morphs
+Added Wiehenvenator Elder and Incest morphs, and improved Wiehevenator mesh

[h3]Skins[/h3]
+Added new Pteranodon Skin: Royal by KrymsonFeather & Gortys
+Added Summer Lurdu Skin: Waverider by Soals and Valhalla

[h3]Sounds[/h3]
+Updated mosa sounds for Aggro, Call, Roar, Submissive, Distress, Bite, Breath, Death, Idle, Eat, Pain low med and high
+Updated Pteranodon vocal calls, attack sounds, swimming "footstep" sound, and added new sleep idle sound

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/721529804704448593/1126289531314897047/image.png?width=1205&height=676[/img]
[h2]Foliage Placement Tool[/h2]
+While using the foliage placement tool, AI critter spawn points and player spawn points are now visible and show sprites above their locations
+Added MapSpawnPointInhibitor to the foliage placement tool.  Place this on top of spawn points to keep them from being used for spawning
    -It can be made to cover more area by adjusting its scale
    -Any spawn points inside the big red bubble it displays will no longer ever be used
    -Deleting a spawn point inhibitor with the foliage placement tool will automatically re-enable any spawn points previous covered by the deleted inhibitor
+Added flyer, terrestrial, and aquatic spawn points to the foliage placement tool
    -Dinosaurs will spawn at the little dinosaur head sprite.  The camera spawns at the target sprite icon.  Be careful not to place spawn points such that players will spawn under the map
    -Spawn points placed with the foliage placement tool will automatically assign themselves an appropriate spawn region on maps with spawn regions
+Added MapBorderWall to the foliage placement tool.  
    -This, combined with using the Map Spawn Point Inhibitor, allows players to partition a piece of a map they wish for players to be able to access.  It could allow players to make smaller servers where only a smaller part of the map is accessable.  This should make the Volcano Bay map significantly more attractive for usage by map editors due to being able to use only part of this huge map
    -Creating a complete wall enclosing a collection of spawn points that are not inhibited will automatically form a closed playable area, which means eggs, carcasses, and fat plants will only spawn within the playable area.
    -If this does not work, make sure all spawn points outside the playable area you wish to partition off have been inhibited with spawn point inhibitors
+Actor mode can now be used on Isla Titania
+Players will always have 100% complete on the Shrines Visited, Water Sources Visited, and Biomes Visited Trials if the playable area of the map contains none of the relevant map destinations that trigger these Trials
+The Biomes Visited, Water Sources Visited, and Shrines Visited Trials should now automatically exclude water sources, shrines, and biomes that are outside player-placed map borders when considering the requirements of these Trials
    -The Trial requirements should automatically update when border walls on the map are placed or removed, and should automatically update when spawn points are added or removed
    -In order for this to work, the border wall needs to form a complete circuit around all of the spawn points on the map that have not been blocked with spawn point inhibitors
+World event nodes outside the playable map area will automatically disable and no longer be considered for world event generation
+Added Titania Kelps (Seaweed3) to the foliage placement tool
+Added Titania's little green seaweeds (Seaweed2) to FPT
+Replaced Orange and Lemon trees with optimized variants, plus added younger tree versions (Lemon and Orange Bush)

[h2]Steam Deck Fixes[/h2]
+SteamDeck should now load optimized settings for it 
+SteamDeck now uses it's keyboard when writing in chat
+Proton compatibility layer no longer applies the Steam Deck's resolution's aspect ratio wrong
+Updated several UI texts such that they should read easier on Steam Deck
+Beasts of Bermuda now has its own, thematically appropriate glyph that shows up while using the mouse as an input device.  This can be turned off in the gameplay options menu if the player wishes to use the default mouse cursor instead.

[h3]Default Controller Config[/h3]
    -Under the default controller configuration for Steam Deck, the following should now be true:
    -Swim Strafe Left/Right is bound to D-pad Left/Right
    -Crouch is bound to the B button
    -All vocal calls such as Distress Call should be accessable through the emote action menu, which opens up when the player holds the D-up down button
    -Chat, Autorun, Toggle HUD, Toggle Group Tags, Talent Screen, Screenshot Mode is accessed by pressing D pad up and then pressing Y
    -Character Menu can be accessed by pressing the menu button and selecting the Character Menu option on the escape screen
    -Yes / No are also bound to D-pad left / right

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/965032727806091354/1126322448309178439/image.png?width=1202&height=676[/img]
[h2]Mechanics Changes[/h2]
+Mechanics: Charcoal now grants a lot of comfort bias if you have the Food Poisoning status condition
+Mechanics: Charcoal now grants a lot of water satiation if you have the Water Poisoning status condition
+Mechanics: The talent Sneaky now makes sniffing sounds quieter 
+Mechanics: Babies no longer play the 2 call when picked up by a friendly group member
+Mechanics: Good parent now affects the chances of passing your skin genes by up to 15% if the difference between your points and your mate's is 3 or more.
+Mechanics: The amount of depth pressure you can resist now caps at 1.2, rather than continuing to get deeper as you grow larger+Mechanics: Adjusted the Pressure debuff such that it is reached at 80% the depth it was reached at before for all creatures other than Kronosaurus
+Mechanics: The talent Out of Element no longer applies two stacking damage increases if it is raining and in a situation where the talent would otherwise also activate
+Mechanics: Reduced speed of the Arganodus fish
+Mechanics: Anemones and shellfish now count as the fish food type
+Mechanics: Increased rate at which foliage or other edible objects flash while holding scent
+Mechanics: Carcasses dropped inside Death's Blessing world events are now 50% their regular size
    -Note that servers that wish to enable or disable auto-revives during a server's runtime can do so by using the SetDisableDeath console command instead if they're currently doing so by using the Death's Blessing world event
+Mechanics: The power deity blessing now lasts one hour, up from 30 minutes
+Mechanics: Being larger growth no longer makes pteras take less additional injury while in flight

[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
+QoL: The delete dinosaur button is now red with a danger icon on it
+QoL: The egg HUD now flashes and remains red if you take damage to eggs you are gestating
+QoL: When sturdy is used or it's not active because health is lower than 90%, the red outline around health is active
+QoL (public): The prompt that appears when you're deleting a saved creature now shows the growth and slot name of the creature
+QoL (public): Improved Ptera's roar second variant sound
+Pressing the delete key while selecting a creature on the save select screen now initiates deletion of the creature
+QoL: Improved the use key interaction with velo when ability key climbing is enabled. Eating, drinking and grabbing should work as good as with ability key climbing disabled.
+QoL: Pachy now blinks and closes its eyes when it sleeps 

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/965032727806091354/1126336382726590654/image.png?width=1220&height=676[/img]
[h2]Compass and Player Scent[/h2]
+Compass: Added a compass that shows up in the top-center of the screen while you are holding the scent key
+The compass has several different point of interest icons that show up.  This includes icons for:
[list]
[*] Fresh water bodies within 250 meters
[*] Non-empty Carcasses that you have interacted with previously if within 500 meters
[*] Fat plants within 250 meters if a herbivore
[*] Nests belonging to you or players in your group if within 2000 meters of the nest
[*] Burrow entrances that are yours or your group-mates if within 250 meters
[*] World events within 10000 meters
[*] Major shrines show up from 1000 meters away. Minor shrines still show up from 250 meters away. Major shrines have a decorator on their compass icon image
[/list]
+Compass: Objects further from the player will show up as a smaller icon on the compass

+Player Scents: Players now accumulate scent continuously at their current location.  This scent is categorized by the species they are playing
    -Large growth players accumulate scent more quickly, and players below 0.7 growth accumulate no scent
    -Multiple players of the same species type all stack on top of each other, all accumulating and contributing scent of their species type simultaneously
    -As players change location, the scent contribution they're generating will shift around as well
    -Scent in a geographic area will collect and show up as one large scent of that species type on the compass.  As scents accumulate in different parts of the map, they will collect into separate scent hotspots that are automatically calculated and clumped into regions.  This is what shows up on the compass as creature scent hotspots
+Player Scents: A 1.0 player will accumulate enough scent to show up on the compass after about 10 minutes of staying in the same location.  When they show up, they can be smelt 63,000 UE units away.  If they stay in this area indefinitely, it will make them smellable from 94000 UE units away
+Player Scents: Areas with very large growth creatures or large groups of creatures may become easily detectable across the entire map in relatively short periods of time
+Player Scents: Creatures who are swimming, flying, or in a burrow do not accumulate scent that shows up on the compass
+Player Scents: Stronger creature scents have a more defined border on the compass
+Player Scents: Creature scent is vague, and when a player is relatively close to the location of a creature scent, it will move to the center of the compass, indicating the player is surrounded by the scent of that creature and can no longer tell which direction it's coming from.  This is not a system that pinpoint's a player's location.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
+Balance: Grab immunity and grab diminishing returns now lasts for 40 seconds, up from 30
+Balance: Having the Pressure status condition now reduces the rate at which your Ability Power and Stamina regenerate
+Balance: While beached, ability power now drains twice as fast if you are grabbing another player

[h3]Apato[/h3]
+Balance: Apato can now kick while grabbed by a mosa

[h3]Elasmo[/h3]
+Balance: Elasmo now gets its ability power refunded when eating fish, crystals, sponges, or other edible objects

[h3]Ichthy[/h3]
+Balance: Ichthy's walk speed is now 450, down from 525

[h3]Lurdu[/h3]
+Balance: Lurdu's weight stat is now 1100, up from 1000
+Balance: Lurdu's base health is now 1150, up from 1000
+Balance: Reduced Lurdusaurus eat hitbox size by 50%
+Balance: Increased Lurdusaurus growth rate by 11%

[h3]Mosa[/h3]
+Balance: Reduced Mosa's grab range by 20%

[h3]Ptera[/h3]
+Balance: Ptera now takes 50% more injury while in flight
+Balance: When in flight, reduced injury resistance growth scaling by 100%
+Balance: Increased the influence injury has over flight 
+Balance: Reduced Aerial Acrobatics' speed boost to 1800, down from 2213
+Balance: After being hit while in flight, flyers now must wait one second before re-entering flight

[h3]Tropeo[/h3]
+Balance: When in flight, reduced injury resistance growth scaling by 100%
+Balance: Increased the influence injury has over flight 
+Balance (public): After being hit while in flight, flyers now must wait one second before re-entering flight

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/721529804704448593/1126265385293979861/image.png?width=1202&height=676[/img]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
+Fixed: Console commands such as setspeedincrease now work while using the observer camera
+Fixed: Eggs no longer get negative inherits more often than they should
+Fixed: If both parents have either survival blessing or great nesting site buff the eggs do not receive the random negative inherit
    -This doesn't protect the egg from incest or egg damage negative inherits
+Fixed: ToggleLookUp and AutoLookUp control settings now work properly
    -AutoLookUp will automatically shift the camera to sitting on the player's shoulders while they're holding the look up key if they are also looking up with the camera
    -ToggleLookUp will automatically snap the camera to sitting on the player's shoulders if the look up key is held down
+Fixed: HUD icons no longer get stuck when they are moved to the top left of the screen
+Fixed: Velo should no longer fall through the map when exiting ory burrow
+Fixed: You no longer leave and re-enter world events you're inside while digging as an Oryctodromeus
+Fixed: Eggs now count as Meat in Pachy's diet
+Fixed: Updated Apatosaurus and Lurdusaurus information on the dino select screen to reflect them having neck sweep, kick, and charge, rather than stomp
+Fixed: Ptera no longer stretches after being grabbed and released while swimming
+Fixed: Several map bug reports on Ancestral Plains and Rival Shores
+Fixed: Footsteps not playing properly on muddy terrain
+Fixed: The dinoselect camera and got rid of some of its animations. Reset location now snaps it back to its default point in a frame.
+Fixed: Wiehenvenator scent now properly shows up as Wiehenvenator, not Megalosaurus
+Fixed: Shelters on Titania now properly block mesh bites
+Fixed: HUD icons turning into meat icons should no longer happen even if player hasn't reset the HUD after update
+Fixed: Velo now drops the carried item while in the air by double tapping the use key instead of tapping the use key just once
    -This allows players who are not using ability key climbing to jump and start climbing while holding something in their mouth without dropping the item
+Fixed: Velo can now eat broken eggs in a burrow 
+Fixed: AI now properly deactivate when no players are nearby, improving server performance
+Fixed: Abandoned aquatic eggs now always spawn below the low tide mark, ensuring you always spawn underwater
+Fixed: Exiting chat window with escape key should now close the chat window properly
+Fixed: Aquatics/Semi-Aquatics are no longer able to regen AP in the air after darting by trying to sniff
+Fixed: Velo no longer falls through the ground when force closing the game while climbing
+Fixed: Situation that would cause signficant server log spam when players would stand on objects such as stumps, trees, or certain rocks
+Fixed: Elasmo no longer auto-targets empty carcasses when the player tries to eat
+Fixed: The carcass and meat leg bones no longer have a scent prompt
+Fixed: When you do not meet the full cost of resurrection, the UI for sacrificing creatures no longer implies it resurrects your creature anyways
+Fixed: After getting picked up and dropped by another player while in mid-animation between standing and sitting, player should no longer get stuck in the sitting animation while being able to move
+Fixed: "B, A and S grade Text does not appear" Friendship events on the UI should now display for every friendship event instead of getting stuck after C.
+Fixed: Velo is now able to use sprint key while climbing to stop toggle sprint from draining the stamina while climbing
+Fixed: Game settings should now show correct title text when switching tabs and closing and reopening the settings
+Fixed: Player is now able to stop sprinting during autorun when toggle sprint is enabled
+Fixed: Aquatic creatures no longer get jammed after trying to stop resting when the water level had gone below the creature's body level
+Fixed: Eggs can no longer duel
+Fixed: Velo should no longer play a running animation while jumping right after eating/grabbing
+Fixed: Certain species cap values no longer cause the Full Group debuff to show when the group is exactly full
+Fixed: Entering flight while biting or doing a vocal call after jumping into the air no longer results in a state jam where you cannot attack or do vocal calls as Ptera and Tropeo
+Fixed: Sit, Stand, Lie Down, and Wake Up sounds now reliably play when they should
+Fixed: Ptera now rotates properly when held in another creature's jaw

+SteamDeck should now load optimized settings for it
+SteamDeck now uses it's keyboard when writing in chat
+Proton compatibility layer no longer applies the Steam Deck's resolution's aspect ratio wrong
+Updated several UI texts such that they should read easier on Steam Deck

+Beasts of Bermuda now has its own, thematically appropriate glyph that shows up while using the mouse as an input device. This can be turned off in the gameplay options menu if the player wishes to use the default mouse cursor instead.
+Swim Strafe Left/Right is bound to D-pad Left/Right
+Crouch is bound to the B button
+All vocal calls such as Distress Call should be accessable through the emote action menu, which opens up when the player holds the D-up down button
+Chat, Autorun, Toggle HUD, Toggle Group Tags, Talent Screen, Screenshot Mode is accessed by pressing D pad up and then pressing Y
+Character Menu can be accessed by pressing the menu button and selecting the Character Menu option on the escape screen
+Yes / No are also bound to D-pad left / right
+Mechanics: Charcoal now grants a lot of comfort bias if you have the Food Poisoning status condition
+Mechanics: Charcoal now grants a lot of water satiation if you have the Water Poisoning status condition
+Mechanics: The talent Sneaky now makes sniffing sounds quieter
+Mechanics: Babies no longer play the 2 call when picked up by a friendly group member
+Mechanics: Good parent now affects the chances of passing your skin genes by up to 15% if the difference between your points and your mate's is 3 or more.
+QoL: The delete dinosaur button is now red with a danger icon on it
+QoL: The egg HUD now flashes and remains red if you take damage to eggs you are gestating
+QoL: When sturdy is used or it's not active because health is lower than 90%, the red outline around health is active
+QoL (public): The prompt that appears when you're deleting a saved creature now shows the growth and slot name of the creature
+QoL (public): Improved Ptera's roar second variant sound
+Pressing the delete key while selecting a creature on the save select screen now initiates deletion of the creature
+QoL: Improved the use key interaction with velo when ability key climbing is enabled. Eating, drinking and grabbing should work as good as with ability key climbing disabled.
+QoL: Pachy now blinks and closes its eyes when it sleeps
+Compass: Added a compass that shows up in the top-center of the screen while you are holding the scent key
+The compass has several different point of interest icons that show up. This includes icons for:
+Player Scents: Players now accumulate scent continuously at their current location. This scent is categorized by the species they are playing
+Balance: Grab immunity and grab diminishing returns now lasts for 40 seconds, up from 30
+Balance: Having the Pressure status condition now reduces the rate at which your Ability Power and Stamina regenerate
+Balance: While beached, ability power now drains twice as fast if you are grabbing another player
+Balance: Apato can now kick while grabbed by a mosa
+Balance: Elasmo now gets its ability power refunded when eating fish, crystals, sponges, or other edible objects
+Balance: Ichthy's walk speed is now 450, down from 525
+Balance: Lurdu's weight stat is now 1100, up from 1000
+Balance: Lurdu's base health is now 1150, up from 1000
+Balance: Reduced Lurdusaurus eat hitbox size by 50%
+Balance: Increased Lurdusaurus growth rate by 11%
+Balance: Reduced Mosa's grab range by 20%
+Balance: Ptera now takes 50% more injury while in flight
+Balance: When in flight, reduced injury resistance growth scaling by 100%
+Balance: Increased the influence injury has over flight
+Balance: Reduced Aerial Acrobatics' speed boost to 1800, down from 2213
+Balance: After being hit while in flight, flyers now must wait one second before re-entering flight
+Balance: When in flight, reduced injury resistance growth scaling by 100%
+Balance: Increased the influence injury has over flight
+Balance (public): After being hit while in flight, flyers now must wait one second before re-entering flight

+Fixed: ToggleLookUp and AutoLookUp control settings now work properly

+Fixed: Velo should no longer fall through the map when exiting ory burrow

notes.title: Ancient Awakening
notes.content:
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/664066364662874125/1075190395396427906/Pteranodon_Sneakpeek3.png?width=1356&height=676[/img]
[h1]New Pterandon[/h1]
+The Pteranodon has received an updated model and associated set of animations
[list][*]The new Pteranodon's feathers ruffle if it is young, low on comfort, or have low health
[*]The Pteranodon has male and female morphs, as well as elder male and elder female morphs[/list]
+While in flight, the Pteranodon can now press the Ability key to receive a brief but rather intense burst of speed and maneuverability
[list][*]This ability is named Aerial Acrobatics
[*]This burst of speed and maneuverability lasts a couple seconds and tapers off after
[*]It costs Ability Power to use Aerial Acrobatics
[*]The speed boost from Aerial Acrobatics increases damage dealt with Piercing Beak[/list]
+Ptera has a dancing emote that unlocks when you do something secret

[h3]Pteranodon Skins[/h3]
+Remade: Phantom Shimmer Pteranodon by Twilightwolf
+Remade: Coastal Pteranodon by Omnomnomnivore
+Remade: Sunrun Pteranodon by Twilightwolf
+New Skin: Seagull Pteranodon by Callie & Krymsonfeather
+New Skin: Cloudy Pteranodon by Triptrap & Natahi4
+New Skin: Monarch Pteranodon by Valhalla & GamevideosforLife

[h3]Other New Skins[/h3]
+Added new Apatosaurus Skin:  Netted Vine, by Nonyapie & Valhalla

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/605979793716019205/1092682910089367552/springevent.png?width=1202&height=676[/img]
[h2]Spring Event Shimmer Skin[/h2]
+Added Shimmer Spring Skin: Spring Guardian by Soals and Twilightwolf
[list][*]This is a shimmer skin and requires unlocking by growing an Apatosaurus to 1.32 Growth on a Life Cycle server
[*]If this skin is unlocked, it will be available for you to use across all servers.  This includes Free Roam and Combat servers.
[*]The skin will be unlockable throughout the month of April
[*]This skin has a special, mossy layer that goes on top of the skin.  If this skin is unlocked, this layer can be applied to any other Apatosaurus skin
[*]This skin has bioluminescence on the body, inside the mouth, the tips of the spikes on the Apatosaurus' crest, and on the eyes[/list]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/721529804704448593/1092638974272602132/image.png?width=1202&height=676[/img]
[h2]Mechanics Changes[/h2]
+Mechanics: All talents have been reset for this patch
+Mechanics: While in a burrow, if you're not an Oryctodromeus, a Velociraptor, or Auroraceratops you now very rapidly become restless.
+Mechanics: Players who have the Snowflake Para skin should now be able to access it on any server after they log on and log off the server they initially unlocked it on.
+Mechanics: Players no longer see the "mate with" icon on player list with same species creatures unless they are at net-relevance range to each other, are opposite genders, and unless they are mating age
    -Admins can still see this icon
+Mechanics: The diets for all creatures capable of eating eggs has been updated. A diet must not consist of more than a certain fraction of food from eggs or else an egg-related dietary wariness or sickness will be incurred.
    -Megaraptor, Velociraptor, Pachycephalosaurus, Pteranodon, and Tropeognathus do not have a max egg contraint on their diet because they have Nest Raider

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
+QoL: Text prompt shows up when sturdy is ready 
+QoL: Text prompt shows up when sturdy is disabled because health is below 90%
+QoL: Health flashes shortly when sturdy is activated 
+QoL: Text prompt shows up when sturdy is activated
+QoL: Chat scrolls to bottom when chat key (enter-key) is pressed to start chatting
+QoL: Changed the text color of world events
+QoL: Added new console command that all players can use.  UseRandomName.  It will generate a random name for the player to use and set them as it.  If you want to go back to your previous name, type UseRandomName again. 
+QoL: Added a functional replacement for annoyingdinosaur 
    -Added the public command "BlockPlayer <name/id/steam>" which blocks a player locally. This prevents them from receiving messages or requests from the blocked player.
    -Another command, "UnblockPlayer <name/id/steam>" unblocks them.
+QoL: Server setting info box: 
    -Server's settings should now be displayed correctly when server is clicked on server list
    -Server info box is now scrollable if there are even more settings
    -Added empty line between settings if on some language the phrase is too long to fit on one line to make it more readable
+QoL: You can now lock layers while customizing a skin, by right clicking on the color you want locked. (Visuals pending)
    -The locked state is transient, and resets when the editor is closed.
+QoL: Adjusted status condition's info popup background so that the text is more readable, even when expanded large.
+QoL: Ptera and Tropeo can now preview their flight animation while on the dino select screen so the wings can be seen more easily
+QoL: Server list now scales up better on different sized monitors 
+QoL: Server list's header keeps up better with server rows
+QoL: Added a custom cursor toggle in the settings under Gameplay Options / UI Settings
    -Swapping custom cursor back to system default cursor requires a restart

[h3]Admin[/h3]
+Admin: The admin observer camera can now pick up carcasses
+Admin: Added mini shrines to the foliage placement admin tool.  There are terrestrial and aquatic variants for each deity.
+Admin: You can now spawn fat plants and carcasses while in the Life Cycle game mode when you have the appropriate server admin permissions

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/721529804704448593/1092664521363038208/image.png?width=1082&height=676[/img]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
+Balance: Reduced the effectiveness of the Scavenger talent at mitigating comfort loss from eating Chinlea fish by 50%
+Balance: Buffed the Clotting talent by about 40%
+Balance: Reduced the damage reduction associated with having bleed
+Balance: The playable frog and horseshoe crab now receives the Storm Lord buff
+Balance: Increased food value Chinlea give to piscivores by 33%
+Balance: Decreased food value Chinlea give to non-piscivores by 33%
+Balance: The talent Nest Raider now additionally provides damage mitigation against the creature you are grabbing
+Balance: For Megaraptor, Tropeognathus, Pteranodon, and Velociraptor, Eggs now count as Meat in the diet
+Balance: Adjusted the Piscivore diets such that they aren't as strict on fish or meat requirements

[h3]Apatosaurus[/h3]
+Balance: Increased Apatosaurus' healing by 20%

[h3]Coahuilaceratops[/h3]
+Balance: Coah now takes 40% less stamina damage from attacks involving Exhausting Bite

[h3]Elasmosaurus[/h3]
+Balance: Increased Elasmosaurus turn rate while darting to 0.7x to match Mosasaurus
+Balance: Increased Elasmo base hp to 800, up from 625
+Balance: Increased Elasmo base damage to 100, up from 80
+Balance: Elasmo now deals bleed damage
+Balance: Elasmo now can eat horseshoe crabs, starfish, anemones, seashells
    -Starfish give Fish diet, anemones and horseshoe crabs give Meat diet, and Seashells are bone
+Balance: Lowered Elasmo's dart cost to 20 AP / 13 STA, down from 24 AP / 16 STA
+Balance: Elasmo will no longer auto-target and eat poisonous objects such as starfish or rotweed
+Balance: Elasmo now has Serrated Teeth instead of Sharp Teeth
    -Any inherits in Sharp Teeth will transfer over into Serrated Teeth

[h3]Ichthyovenator[/h3]
+Balance: Increased Ichthy dart damage hitbox size

[h3]Kronosaurus[/h3]
+Balance: Increased Krono's lunge base damage to 150, up from 126
+Balance: Increased Kronosaurus size to 3100, up from 2900
+Balance: Krono can now struggle out of grabs
+Balance: Krono can now use its Lunge ability while carrying objects
+Balance: Increased Kronosaurus bite damage to 305, up from 255

[h3]Lurdusaurus[/h3]
+Balance: Increased Lurdusaurus healing by 27%
+Balance: Increased Lurdu dart damage hitbox size

[h3]Mosasaurus[/h3]
+Balance: Replaced Mosa's Adrenaline talent with Slippery
+Balance: Increased Mosasaurus dart cost to 24 Ability, 16 Stamina to match that of Elasmo
+Balance: Adjusted mosa grab Ability Power tick size such that it scales less intensely with growth

[h3]Oryctodromeus[/h3]
+Balance: Increased Oryctodromeus healing by 25%
+Balance: Reduced the amount of travel distance required to get the underground distance traveled trial by 33%

[h3]Parasaurolophus[/h3]
+Balance: Increased Parasaurolophus healing by 20%

[h3]Pteranodon[/h3]
+Balance: Increased Pteranodon's swim sprint speed to 825, up from 775
+Balance: Improved Ptera's swim strafe speed by 50%
+Balance: Increased Pteranodon max hp to 190, up from 150
+Replaced Pteranodon's Improved Braking talent with Improved Acrobatics
    -Improves the braking ability of the pteranodon
    -Improves the dart ability in the exact same manner as Improved Dart
    -Reduces the cost of the Aerial Acrobatics ability
    -Improves the speed boost provided by the Aerial Acrobatics ability
+Balance: Reduced Ptera's base damage to 35, down from 40
+Balance: Reduced Ptera's injury damage dealt by 40% in all circumstances

[h3]Saichania[/h3]
+Balance: Increased Saichania healing by 20%
+Balance: When Saichania's Spiky Shield successfully counters damage, it now receives a temporary 30% speed boost
    -This speed boost last 6.5 seconds
    -This speed boost cannot be activated by grouped players or players who have a positive friendship with the Saichania
    -The speed boost is made stronger by taking the Steadfast talent
    -It will not activate if the Spiky Shield was reflecting damage done by a Sai, Velo, Ptera, or Ory
    -Using Spiky Shield while the speed buff is active will remove the speed buff
+Balance: Sai now automatically continues sprinting after its Spiky Shield ability wears off if the player is holding the sprint key

[h3]Tyrannosaurus rex[/h3]
+Balance: Increased Trannosaurus rex food drain rate by 18%
+Balance: Reduced Tyrannosaurus rex's distance traveled Trial requirement by 33%

[h3]Velociraptor[/h3]
+Balance: Increased Velociraptor healing by 25%
+Balance: Velo can now attack straight up while climbing
+Balance: While ability key climbing is enabled velo can now pick up and drop items while climbing by double tapping use key

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/721529804704448593/1092552942558662766/image.png?width=1141&height=676[/img]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
+Fixed: Tabbing out of the game and clicking any HUD element with left or right mouse click should no longer edit them unless you are in HUD customization menu
+Fixed: HUD elements should no longer turn into meat after editing HUD and applying changes
+Fixed: Reset HUD now properly resets the HUD to default without turning back to edited one after closing the HUD customization
+Fixed: Resizing HUD elements now properly saves the size change without turning back to previous size after closing the HUD customization
+Fixed: HUD changes are now updated immediately instead of changing only after when settings menu is closed
+Fixed: Double tapping use key no longer gets unbind after enabling ability key climbing
+Fixed: Velo's biting hitbox no longer gets deleted while climbing
+Fixed: Misuse of skin labels that caused inconsistent randomization results based on language
+Fixed: Game no longer doesn't let the player log out or quit the game in certain situations.
+Fixed: Mosa now reports that it uses air, rather than water, during decay ticks in combat event messages
+Fixed: The world event barrier now renders on low or medium view distance graphics settings
+Fixed: Chat messages now properly scroll all the way to the bottom of the chat when text input box is closed
+Fixed: Para's ash footprints are now correct
+Fixed: Restlessness now properly happens while in a burrow
+Fixed: When playing with Steam Deck it should now properly open up keyboard when needed
+Fixed: Default Config Performance. When playing with Steam Deck, game now loads proper default settings for 1280 x 800 30fps
+Fixed: Text Legibility. Text in server menu, in settings and in tutorial screens is bigger and more readable on small screen devices such as on Steam Deck
+Fixed: Infinite food on Titania seaweeds
+Fixed: Herbivores can no longer eat bones
+Fixed: You can no longer abuse the unjam button to attack more quickly than intended
+Fixed: Para now loads its normal default skin on selection
+Fixed: Teleporters can no longer cause fall damage 
+Fixed: Growth badges now behave properly for growths of 10.0 or greater
+Fixed: Requests to join eggs would sometimes fail to go to the correct parents if the female had eggs available that had different fathers
+Fixed: Krono can no longer bite while it's charging up lunge it is interrupted, allowing it to damage the other player three times in rapid succession
+Fixed: Spamming the jump key the instant you are grabbed no longer causes your character to disconnect from the grabbing player's jaw
+Fixed: Strafe exploit that would allow flyers to have excessively quick turning rates while flying
+Fixed: Certain situations where Pteranodon or Tropeognathus would fail to take fall damage after landing at excessive speeds
+Fixed: Player's controlled creature no longer sometimes fail to disappear from the map after quitting to main menu or exiting game
+Fixed: Apatosaurus can now struggle attack if it is grabbed while sitting down
+Fixed: You can no longer infinitely drink from water sources by interacting with them while holding foliage
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Additional Patchnote Languages:[/h3]
[url=https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/741512364503072779/1093513593804308491/Ancient_Awakening_Afr.txt]Afrikaans[/url]

notes.title: The World Events Update
notes.content:
[h1]Added the World Event Migration System[/h1]
The World Event Migration system will, by default, spawn a world event players can choose to migrate to on the map every 2 hours.  World Events provide a pair of two randomly-selected benefits to the player if they are in the world event area.  They spawn at a randomly selected world event node.  We have placed world event nodes on Isla Titania, Rival Shores, Forest Island, Ancestral Plains, DM_Caldera, and canvas maps.  The majority of world event nodes are accessible to both aquatics and terrestrials.

When a world event spawns, it will begin a count-down until it actually begins providing the benefits.  This count-down is, by default, 30 minutes.  Once the countdown finishes, it will provide its benefits for 45 more minutes.  After that, it will despawn.  World events have large, golden banners that show up when you use scent.  The banners have a count-down until the event starts, and a count-down for when the event is over.  They also show what benefits the world event will provide.

There are eight world event benefit types currently implemented.
[h3]List of World Event Benefits[/h3]
[b]+Immune to Weather[/b]
    -You are immune to the adverse effects of weather
    -This includes lightning strikes, tornados, and discomfort associated with weather

[b]+Slower Metabolism[/b]
    -The rate at which your food and water deplete has been reduced by 33%

[b]+Death's Blessing[/b]
    -Upon death, you will automatically resurrect without any penalty to growth.  This includes Life Cycle, Gauntlet growth creatures
    -You will respawn at a randomly selected spawn point on the map when this creature is selected for play

[b]+Bountiful Lands[/b]
    -Increases AI spawner activity in the area, greatly accelerating spawn rate and max spawn count
    -Dramatically increases rate at which foliage respawns when eaten

[b]+Great Nesting Site[/b]
    -Provides all buffs the Survival Deity Blessing provides.  They do not, however, stack with the Survival 

[b]+Deity Blessing buffs[/b]
    -Additionally, offspring will receive inherits as if the difference between your Good Parent talent and that of a creature with 5/3 invested has been halved

[b]+Enhanced Growth[/b]
    -Increases growth rate by 30%

[b]+Favor of the Deities[/b]
    -Provides a very powerful buff that corresponds with which deity you have pledged to
    -With the [u]power deity pledge[/u] active, you receive:
        -45% more base damage.  This does not increase injury or stamina damage.
        -45% more bleed damge
        -100% more intimidation
        -50% further fall distance

    -With the [u]speed deity pledge[/u] active, you receive:
        -25% boost to jump power
        -35% boost to walking, sprinting, swimming, and flying movement speed
        -20% boost to turn rate
        -35% reduced injury damage taken
        -35% reduced stamina damage taken
        -Deal damage as if you have 3 additional points in Exhausting Bite

    -With the [u]survival deity pledge[/u] active, you receive:
        -65% increased health.  Note this also reduces incoming injury damage by 39%
        -50% reduced bleed damage taken
        -65% increased healing rate.  This includes bleed, injury, and venom healing
        -45% more injury damage

[b]+Unlocked Skin Editing[/b]
    -You can edit your skin at any time while in the event area

+Additionally, inside any world event, you receive the equivalent of the Power Deity Blessing, meaning when you die, 75% of the resurrection cost to resurrect the creature will automatically be met
    -If you have the Power Deity Blessing as well, 100% of the cost to resurrect will be met, making resurrection free and incur no growth penalty on Free Roam. On Life Cycle, your resurrected growth will be the minimum value of your current growth and 1.32.
+While in a world event area, water can also not be further dirtied

[h3]World Event Server Configs[/h3]
World Events have several server config variables that allow server owners to control how these behave on their server.  They go in the ServerGameInstance section.  They are:

[b]bSpawnWorldEvents[/b]
    -If true, world events spawn on the server.

[b]WorldEventPrepTime[/b]
    -Defaults to 30 minutes.  How long it takes for the world event to activate and provide its benefits, once it spawns.

[b]WorldEventDuration[/b]
    -Defaults to 45 minutes.  How long the world event provides its benefits for.

[b]WorldEventSpacing[/b]
    -Defaults to 120 minutes.  Time between each world event spawn.

[b]WorldEventBuffsToNotUse[/b]
    -Populate this array to disable spawning of certain event benefits on the server.  If a benefit is disabled, world events will never choose to use this benefit and will choose others randomly instead.

[u]Example:[/u]
!WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=ClearArray
WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_WeatherImmunity
WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_LowFoodWaterDrain
WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_AutoResurrection
WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_AISwarm
WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_Nesting
WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_GrowthBuff
WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_PledgeAmplify
WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_Reskin

[h2]World Event Console Commands[/h2]
World events can be spawned with the console as well, running the command SpawnWorldEventAt.  You can provide the location, the benefits it provides, the radius, the prep time, and the duration.  The event will handle itself and do everything else on its own.  These world events are totally independent from the naturally spawned ones the game will generate on its own, and will not interfere with natural world event spawning.  Multiple world events can cover the same area if you spawn two or more that overlap. 

+The console command SpawnWorldEventAt has two input arguments for what world event buffs it will spawn.  It expects a number from 1 to 8.

+Here is a list of all world events and their corresponding numbers:
1: EVENT_WeatherImmunity
2: EVENT_LowFoodWaterDrain
3: EVENT_AutoResurrection
4: EVENT_AISwarm
5: EVENT_Nesting
6: EVENT_GrowthBuff
7: EVENT_PledgeAmplify
8: EVENT_Reskin
+There is also a command, [i]DestroyAllWorldEvents[/i], which removes all events.

We designed this system to give players an optional, additional, occasional goal they can seek out on the map while playing and we hope it'll add to the gameplay experience!

[h3]Additional Notes about World Events[/h3]
+World Events now grant an "Event Pending" status condition while inside the event radius if the event is still counting down
+Two world events cannot spawn naturally at the same location
+World Events cannot spawn at the same world event location twice in a row
+World Events send green chat messages to global chat when they first spawn on the map, when they first begin providing buffs, when they despawn, and every 15 minutes leading up to the event.  They state what buffs will be present at the event.
+When you exit a world event, the benefits fade out over 10 seconds and you receive a screen message informing you that you've left the event area
+When a world event despawns, the benefits from the world event now fade out over 30 seconds and you receive a screen message informing you that the event has despawned
+Events with a weather immunity buff also trigger a rainstorm when they start, so long as it's not already raining
+Added World Event Node to the foliage placement tool.  The default event radius is 10000 UE units, and is further multiplied by the object scale.  If a node exists, it may be selected by the world event system to naturally spawn events on its own and will be added to the regular map world event nodes.  These save and load properly when the server restarts.
+The Favor of the Deities world event benefit now always pairs with the Death's Blessing benefit if it is selected as the first benefit and Death's Blessing is a valid benefit for selection (not blocked by server config).  This means Favor of the Deities and Death's Blessing will frequently pair up during world events, but not always.
+World events provide immunity to necrophobia

[h3]World Events Webhooks[/h3]
Notes on the world event webhooks:
-They work the same as other webhooks.
-bUseEventsWebhook is the config variable to enable or disable them
-EventsDiscordWebhook is the config variable on which the webhook link should be placed
-EventsDiscordIconURL is the config variable on which a link to an image can be put (optional)

[u]Example:[/u]
bUseEventsWebhook=True
EventsDiscordWebhook="123456/examplekey_dwdhwaowdawbdwaowdcic11938374-ce"
EventsDiscordIconURL=""

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/957700226431479818/1032419763412029551/unknown.png?width=1082&height=676[/img]
[h2]Mechanics Changes[/h2]
+Velo now tries to automatically latch if it falls from climb 
    -It still can't latch if the surface is not suitable for climbing due to it's shape or angle

[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
+QoL: Quick chat has new phrases: Thank you!, Sorry!, Help me!, Attack!, Fall back!, I need food/water
+QoL: Added frog critter spawners to Rival Shores, Rival Shores Canvas, Ancestral Plains, Ancestral Plains Canvas, Forest Island, Forest Island Canvas, DM_Caldera, DM_Caldera Canvas
+QoL: Moved the out of bounds duel message to the top-center of the screen
+QoL: Ai can now be seen while using scent regardless of whether the player is above or below the Ocean surface
+QoL: Added mini shrines of each type to each spawn point on DM_Caldera and DM_Caldera_Canvas
+Qol: You can now choose to preserve your skin when reincarnating.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
+Fixed (public): Krono's Lunge attack can now hit AI critters such as the Arganodus
+Fixed: Instances where Wiehevenator was still being referred to as Megalosaurus

[h2]Isla Titania[/h2]
+Palm Forest Creek no longer provides water satiation
+Added more combat music.  Added one while flying, and one while swimming.
+Adjusted Arganodus spawn populations, added more spawners, split spawners which were large into many smaller spawners that add up to the same total area population (optimization)
+Fixed: smoothed out more reported terrain slopes
+Optimizations to Freshwater Plants

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/957700226431479818/1032416974388592721/20221019231123_1.jpg?width=1202&height=676[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[url=https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/741512364503072779/1071134211832021022/WorldEventsPatch_Afr.txt]Afrikaans[/url]

notes.title: Titania Optimization Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2]New Content[/h2]
+Isla Titania's Spiral Island biome now has its own biome discovery soundtrack and its own looping biome soundtrack

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
+Titania no longer continuously consumes more and more RAM as the player moves around the map and loads more map tiles
+Titania should now load much more quickly for players have been struggling to connect to Isla Titania servers
+Various foliage LOD and texture resolution optimizations on Isla Titania

[h2]Admin[/h2]
+Admins can now remove groups from the group finder by clicking an admin-only X by the group in the group finder
+The admin observer camera's ability now shows player's breathbar, estimated attack damage, estimated sprint speed, and current speed

[h2]Mechanics[/h2]
+Megaraptor now continues sprinting if the sprint key is already held down when the player stops using Slash Attack
+Megaraptor now automatically cancels Slash Attack if the player jumps, rather than preventing the player from jumping
+Carcass legs now rot at the same rate as the parent carcass. This means legging carcasses no longer adversely influences how fast they rot or how much food value they're worth.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
+The prompt that asks to view replays or record replays now has cancel button to close the prompt

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
+Empty "Sand Attack" status condition icons getting stuck on the status display
+Quickly tapping the use key no longer gets you stuck in a drinking state, allowing you to drain water sources below their intended drink level
+The plant moving to mouth eating effect now works properly for plants that have a non-unity scale
+Megaraptor's Evasive Maneuver now properly fully cancels when you do a regular jump
+Teleporters no longer cause creatures to take fall damage, get stuck, or die
+Replay menu no longer gets stuck on screen after selecting view replays and hitting esc
+Emote wheel no longer can be opened in rare cases while replay UI is open
+Wie's identification now properly uses a word Air instead of Water when checking aquatic creature's stats
+Various Titania map issues

notes.title: Winter Holiday Surprise Patch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31308067/f63e279c02039ad65f04bff2d2bfd886d0c170a9.png[/img]
[h2]Added seasonal Parasaurolophus Winter Skin[/h2]
+This skin can be unlocked by growing a Parasaurolophus to Gauntlet age (1.32) on any server running the Life Cycle game mode
    -This skin will no longer be earnable after[b] December 31st[/b]!  It's possible we will allow it to be earned again in future events
    -When the skin is unlocked, an achievement for earning the winter skin will display, granting the player the ability to select and use this skin
    -It will always be available to the player once it has been unlocked on the server they unlocked it on
    -The unlock for this skin is server-specific, meaning it needs to be unlocked separately on each if a player wishes to have the skin on multiple servers
+The dusting of snow on top of the model can be toggled on or off in the character tab
+The skin is fully customizable, including the colors of the blanket

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/664066364662874125/1050895867814609007/Frogs.png?width=1203&height=676[/img]
[h2]Frogs[/h2]
+Frog AI have been placed around the majority of water sources on Isla Titania.  They are also present in some other swampy areas of the map as well.
    -The frogs are a simple, easy to catch AI critter that provide about half the food value of an Auroraceratops
    -The carcass spawn rate has been slightly reduced to accommodate for the addition of frogs as a new, additional food source for carnivores

notes.title: Titania: Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2]New Mechanic: Deity Shrine Blessings[/h2]
+All deity shrines now have two additional options the player can do while interacting with the shrine.  These are Receive Blessing and Take Trinket.
+Blessings offer a way for players to voluntarily ramp up the difficulty of the game to receive various benefits for a period of time.  These benefits have been deliberately designed to not influence combat-related stats or gameplay balance.
+Blessings are removed upon death and cannot be removed by the player in any other way.  They must run their course.
+You can have multiple blessings at once.  Their effects stack.
+Blessings can be received at shrines on all maps and in both the Free Roam and Life Cycle game modes
+You can refresh a blessing and restart its timer by revisiting a corresponding deity shrine and receiving the blessing again.
+Blessings last 30 minutes.
+You must take a trinket from another shrine and carry it to a shrine to receive a blessing from the shrine
    -The Take Trinket option can be found by interacting with a shrine through the use key.  The trinket will appear in your mouth and is interactable like any other carryable object

[b]The Survival Deity grants a blessing that does:[/b]
    -Reduces comfort drop associated with incubating eggs by 50%
    -Reduces the movement penalty associated with incubating eggs by 100%
    -Grants increased gestation speed by 75%
    -Increases chance of passing on exclusive skins or granting bio layers on eggs.  Both parents stack.
    -Buffs Incubated buff by an additional 25%
    -Your eggs cannot be damaged from damage received during combat
    -Nests are 50% cheaper to create
    -Each parent reduces the chance of eggs having a negative inherit by 50%.  If both parents are blessed, the chance becomes zero.
    -Increases food and water drain by 40%

[b]The Speed Deity grants a blessing that does:[/b]
    -Increases growth speed by 50%
    -Increases food and water drain by 75%

[b]The Power Deity grants a blessing that does:[/b]
    -If you die, 75% of your resurrection cost is already met by the blessing
    -Increases food and water drain by 40%

[h2]Mechanics Changes[/h2]
+Mechanics: After being resurrected, creatures now drop empty carcasses until they eat and drink food.  The fullness of the dropped carcass cannot exceed the value of the food they have eaten since being resurrected to prevent farming food with the new power deity blessing.
+Mechanics: Life Cycle (Titania) and Life Cycle (old BoB maps) has been split into two game modes.  These game modes are Life Cycle and Free Roam
    -The old, unused Free Roam game mode has been replaced by this updated version of Free Roam, which constitutes all of the current, old BoB map growth mechanics
    -Servers that wish to use old BoB growth and mechanics on Isla Titania can do so by switching the game mode to Free Roam on their Isla Titania server
    -Conversely, all servers who wish to run the current Titania / Gauntlet gameplay can do so on older maps by setting their server's game mode to Life Cycle
    -All mechanics labeled as Titania-specific or for new BoB maps only in our previous update are now specific to Life Cycle
+Mechanics: Titania can now be run on Free Roam (old BoB growth / gameplay) or Life Cycle (Titania / Gauntlet gameplay)
    -Rival Shores, Ancestral Plains, Forest Island, and other maps can also run either Life Cycle or Free Roam

[h3]Admin[/h3]
+Admin: The fillallstats and setstats admin commands no longer dirty dinosaurs if used on the Free Roam game mode
+Admin: The setweather command now applies the Enhanced Growth buff on the Free Roam game mode
+Admin: The server config bDisableCharacterDeath now allows players to automatically resurrect when they die while on Free Roam game mode
+Admin: The console commands SpawnCarcass and SpawnPlant can be used on Free Roam, regardless of map
+Admin: The growth rate, water drain rate, and food drain rate server configs now fully work on Life Cycle/Titania
+Admin: PvE, PvP, and PvPvE game experiences can be used on Life Cycle or Free Roam

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
+QoL: Plants now despawn by going towards your jaw and disappearing gradually, rather than instantly despawning
+QoL: Added a few biome volumes to Forest Island and Forest Island Canvas maps
+Disabled prompt that warns players about joining non-Titania maps
+QoL: Deity shrines now have banners above them that show up when you use scent.  They look similar to freshwater banners

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
+Balance: Decreased Velociraptor's food drain rate by 10%
+Balance: Decreased Oryctodromeus' food drain rate by 10%
+Balance: Increased Tyrannosaurus rex's food drain rate by 6%

[h2]Optimization Changes[/h2]
+Optimization: Reduced size of several textures present on Titania to reduce VRAM usage
+Optimization: Titania now pre-caches before the player attempts to join the server.  This may help with some players with lower-end PCs having issues connecting to Isla Titania servers.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
+Fixed: Charcoal no longer spawns on old maps, neither from forest fires nor randomly
+Reset talents for all creatures
    -This will hopefully flush out any issues with talents not working properly for pre-patch lurdus and megaras
+Fixed: AI can no longer spawn multiple or infinite carcasses under certain situations
+Fixed: Eggs now properly grow 80% faster on Isla Titania
+Fixed: Big burrow objects such as rocks no longer spawn above-ground in areas such as Titania's Salt Marsh
+Fixed: Creatures that have greater than 100 max food now properly receive the Starvation debuff when they are below 20% food, rather than when they are below 20 food
+Fixed: You can no longer get sick from eating negative bias plants on old maps, and sickness no longer permanently gets stuck on old maps
+Fixed: The Auroraceratops playable critter can no longer receive the Restless debuff for spending too much time in burrows
+Fixed: Exiting an ory burrow that is beneath shelter no longer causes the night filter and other post-processing effects to fail to apply properly
+Fixed: Burrows no longer fail to load properly in certain locations on Titania, getting stuck indefinitely prompting the player that they're still loading
+Fixed: Players on old bob maps no longer receive a prompt stating their growth has been paused
+Fixed: SetSpeedIncrease should now work on the Observer Cam
+Fixed various Titania bugs
+Fixed: Wie eggs now show as wie eggs properly instead of megalo
+Fixed: Eggs no longer cause a frame hitch when peeping
+Fixed: Group joins now display the proper dino name instead of the internal name in case of mixed groups
+Fixed: Some some biomes on Ancestral Plains not being set with the proper bounds
+Fixed: Ancestral Plains Canvas, Forest Island Canvas, and Rival Shores Canvas now have biomes
+Fixed: Kapok trees can no longer be picked up or eaten on Isla Titania, resulting in infinite food
+Fixed: Issue where some bio dinos have their bio appearing only when wet
